input: Draft a scholarship application essay for my masters program

gold.taskTitle: Draft a Masters Scholarship Application Essay
gold.taskDescription: Write a compelling scholarship application essay tailored to the user's masters program and target scholarship.

questions.title: Which specific scholarship or organization are you applying to?
questions.description: Identify the exact scholarship name and issuing body to tailor the essay appropriately.

questions.title: What field or subject is your masters program in?
questions.description: Understand the academic discipline so the essay content and tone align with the field.

questions.title: What is the official essay prompt or question given?
questions.description: Obtain the exact prompt to ensure the essay directly addresses what is being asked.

questions.title: What is the required word count or page limit?
questions.description: Know the length constraints to structure the essay correctly from the start.

questions.title: What key experiences or achievements should be highlighted?
questions.description: Gather the user's most relevant academic, professional, or personal accomplishments to feature.

questions.title: What are your specific career goals after the masters program?
questions.description: Understand the user's post-graduation ambitions to build a persuasive future-focused narrative.

questions.title: When is the application deadline for this scholarship?
questions.description: Establish the submission deadline to set realistic drafting and revision timelines.
